lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for choose_path (layout, notification, redesign), adoption (new_flow, new_screen), finish hint, and home redesign due to having only single tests.
Home new_flow remains the only helpful kind of change with one winning test (interactive waiting room), though four other home new_flow tests showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen (3 tests), finish copy (2 tests), choose_path copy (2 tests), and sign_in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Sign_in hints (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (2 tests) produced no winning tests, showing no clear effect or negative impact.
Predictions were overall overly optimistic, consistently predicting larger gains than measured after noise correction.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for adoption (new_flow, new_screen), choose_path (layout, notification, redesign), finish (hint, new_flow), and sign_in layout due to having only single tests.
Home new_flow and choose_path copy are the only helpful kinds of change, each producing one winning test, though other tests of these kinds showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen (3 tests), sign_in hint (3 tests), finish copy (2 tests), sign_in copy (2 tests), and home redesign (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (2 tests) produced no winning tests, showing no clear effect or negative impact.
Predictions were overall overly optimistic across most tests, though predictions for copy changes were occasionally too low (such as the winning Round 7 choose_path copy test).
